title: Ordinary scalar evaluation comparison with its specified unit
statement: Let C be a site with Grothendieck topology J and the essential-smallness instance of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Let B,F be sequences of commutative ring sheaves, tau,sigma their transitions, alpha a transition-compatible scalar map, and A scalar-system data [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. Ordinary scalar extension commutes with evaluation at each natural-number index by natural isomorphisms rho. For every system M the composite of evaluation of the system ordinary adjunction unit, the canonical restriction-evaluation comparison, and restriction of rho equals the finite ordinary adjunction unit at the evaluated M.

source.place: sites-modules.tex, lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (03D7); sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-base-change (06YY) and lemma-adjoint (07A6); step 2 of stage3-pur-extension-strict-derived-comparison.

proof.text: Specialize the sequence-site pullback evaluation theorem to the identity site functor and the scalar ring-system morphism. It proves invertibility of the mate of the identity-on-sections restriction-evaluation comparison under the given ordinary adjunctions.

Take rho to be the inverse of that mate. The standard mate unit identity, followed by restriction of the inverse mate, gives exactly the ordinary unit equation. This construction is natural and applies at every index, including zero.

proof_origin.place: sites-modules.tex, lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (03D7); sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-base-change (06YY) and lemma-adjoint (07A6). Ordinary comparison uses the proved sequence-site mate theorem; normalized units descend from K-flat source resolutions.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryScalarEvaluationUnit :
    ∃ ρ : ∀ n, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ SemilinearSections.evaluation J F σ n ≅
        SemilinearSections.evaluation J B τ n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E,
      ∀ n M,
        (SemilinearSections.evaluation J B τ n).map
            (A.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app M) ≫
          (SemilinearSections.restrictionEvaluation_existsUnique
            J B τ F σ α hα n).exists.choose.hom.app (A.scalar.model.E.obj M) ≫
          (SemilinearSections.res (α n)).map ((ρ n).hom.app M) =
        (A.levels n).ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app
          ((SemilinearSections.evaluation J B τ n).obj M)
